name: GIRDER 格拉德 Dash endurance press-fit T700/T800 Ultegra Di2
why_interesting: The earlier ROAD-section DASH is an endurance bike, not the 2025 DASH all-rounder: Ultegra Di2 R8170 on a T700 + T800 frame with 50 mm wheels at an official ¥18,800.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra Di2 R8170 2×12; FC-R8100 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R8100 11-34T cassette, CN-M8100 chain
facts.frame: ROAD-section DASH T700 + T800 carbon endurance frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully hidden routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded endurance frame and fork with hidden routing; the frame line does not name the BB type
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: Shell standard not named in the frame line; the supplied in-house ceramic-bearing BB (19 G5 silicon-nitride balls) is described as 'PF386 to T47 tool interface', so confirm the exact shell before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Adler Augen wavy-rim ceramic-bearing wheels, 50 mm front and rear
facts.tires: Maxxis M228 700C×28C skinwall folding tires with TPU tubes fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with hidden routing
facts.saddle: Selle Italia saddle and silicone bar tape
facts.sizes: S (448 mm), M (459 mm), L (497 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
